summary: Remove repeated whole-experiment concentration calculations during dense well-plate refreshes.
notes: Full plate refreshes calculate concentration details once. Printer-head pickup refreshes once even when the preview stock stays the same; disabled tooltips skip concentration lookup. Existing formulas and incremental completion updates are preserved, and refresh-local snapshots avoid stale values after calibration or plan changes.

The attended Pi operator confirmed that application commit dfc32e2d resolved the reported repaint issue. The app exited normally, protected invariants matched, released restoration and the complete 30-result SAFE inventory passed, and final status was production-ready with no related processes.

The isolated Windows 384-well/10-stock benchmark measured approximately 15 ms for stock selection and pickup, versus 933 ms and 1889 ms before the fix; all 3840 well/stock display comparisons matched. These are display-path measurements with assumed volume settings, not Pi or full-load timings. Long Pi memory qualification was not rerun at the operator's request.

Firmware, wire protocol, dependencies, saved-data schema and execution-calibration version-4 compatibility requirements are unchanged. Rollback remains unconfigured pending an exact compatible target qualification; preserve execution history and use protected current-version or qualified compatible-bundle recovery.

Stable and pinned rc.11 legacy index routes remain unchanged. Modern clients can discover this schema-v2 candidate only after its tag is published. The previously accepted rc.13 optimizer timing limitation remains separate from this display fix.
Release preparation only: merge, tagging, publication and deployment require the final release decision. Detailed validation and evidence are recorded in docs/plate_refresh_rc15_qualification.md.
